sql.if: , matching_orders AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT o.* FROM pur_order o )

mapper.sql:
SELECT o.id, o.company_id, o.no, o.supplier_id, s.short_name AS supplier_name, s.status AS supplier_status, o.purchase_type, COALESCE(agg.item_count, 0) AS item_count, agg.first_sku_id, o.total_qty, o.total_amount, o.order_date, o.delivery_date, o.warehouse_id, w.name AS warehouse_name, COALESCE(agg.received_qty, 0) AS received_qty, o.buyer_id, c.short_name AS company_name, o.status, o.version, o.create_by, o.create_time , COALESCE(submitted.create_time, o.create_time) AS pending_since FROM matching_orders pur_order o JOIN sup_supplier s ON s.id = o.supplier_id JOIN bas_warehouse w ON w.id = o.warehouse_id JOIN bas_company c ON c.id = o.company_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COUNT(*) AS item_count, SUM(i.received_qty - i.returned_qty) AS received_qty, (array_agg(i.material_sku_id ORDER BY i.seq))[1] AS first_sku_id FROM pur_order_item i WHERE i.purchase_order_id = o.id) agg ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT dl.create_time FROM biz_doc_log dl WHERE dl.doc_type = 'PURCHASE_ORDER' AND dl.doc_id = o.id AND dl.action = 'submit' ORDER BY dl.create_time DESC, dl.id DESC LIMIT 1) submitted ON true

SELECT i.id AS purchase_item_id, o.id AS purchase_order_id, o.no AS purchase_no, o.purchase_type, o.supplier_id, s.short_name AS supplier_name, o.buyer_id, o.warehouse_id, w.name AS warehouse_name, i.material_sku_id, i.purchase_unit, i.qty, i.received_qty, i.returned_qty, COALESCE(i.line_due_date, o.delivery_date) AS due_date, i.expect_date, i.follow_note, i.calc_item_id, o.create_by
FROM pur_order_item i JOIN pur_order o ON o.id = i.purchase_order_id JOIN sup_supplier s ON s.id = o.supplier_id JOIN bas_warehouse w ON w.id = o.warehouse_id

LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT MIN(COALESCE(cut.need_date, required.commit_date - CAST(#{fallbackLeadDays,jdbcType=INTEGER} AS integer))) AS need_date FROM ( SELECT ci.calc_id FROM mrp_calc_item ci JOIN mrp_calc c ON c.id = ci.calc_id WHERE ci.id = i.calc_item_id AND c.status = 'CONFIRMED' UNION SELECT ci.calc_id FROM mrp_calc_transit t JOIN mrp_calc_item ci ON ci.id = t.calc_item_id JOIN mrp_calc c ON c.id = ci.calc_id WHERE t.purchase_item_id = i.id AND c.status = 'CONFIRMED' ) related JOIN mrp_calc_order co ON co.calc_id = related.calc_id JOIN ord_order required ON required.id = co.order_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT MIN(n.plan_start) AS need_date FROM prd_order planned JOIN prd_node n ON n.prd_order_id = planned.id WHERE planned.order_id = required.id AND planned.status IN ('APPROVED', 'RUNNING') AND n.node_code = 'CUT' ) cut ON true ) nd ON true
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COALESCE(i.expect_date, i.line_due_date, o.delivery_date) AS arrive_date) dates

choose.when: AND dates.arrive_date BETWEEN CAST(#{today} AS date) AND CAST(#{today} AS date) + 3

mapper.select:
, GREATEST(i.qty - i.received_qty + i.returned_qty, 0) AS pending_qty, dates.arrive_date, dates.arrive_date - CAST(#{today} AS date) AS days_left, CASE WHEN dates.arrive_date < CAST(#{today} AS date) THEN 'LATE' WHEN dates.arrive_date <= CAST(#{today} AS date) + 3 THEN 'NEAR' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS risk, nd.need_date, GREATEST(dates.arrive_date - nd.need_date, 0) AS cut_late_days
ORDER BY GREATEST(dates.arrive_date - nd.need_date, 0) DESC, dates.arrive_date, o.no, i.id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "all", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE dates.arrive_date < CAST(#{today} AS date)) AS late, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE dates.arrive_date BETWEEN CAST(#{today} AS date) AND CAST(#{today} AS date) + 3) AS near, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE dates.arrive_date > nd.need_date) AS cut

WITH visible_drafts AS ( SELECT DISTINCT i.material_sku_id AS sku_id, o.id, o.no, o.status FROM pur_order_item i JOIN pur_order o ON o.id = i.purchase_order_id WHERE o.purchase_type = 'STOCK' AND o.status IN ('DRAFT', 'PENDING')
AND i.material_sku_id IN #{id}
AND false
AND (o.create_by = #{scope.userId} OR o.buyer_id = #{scope.userId}) ), ranked_drafts AS ( SELECT sku_id, id, no, status, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY sku_id) AS total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sku_id ORDER BY id DESC) AS position FROM visible_drafts ) SELECT sku_id, id, no, status, total FROM ranked_drafts WHERE position <= LEAST(GREATEST(#{limit}, 1), 20) ORDER BY sku_id, id DESC

SELECT d.id, d.no, d.kind, d.doc_type, d.status, d.doc_date, w.name AS warehouse_name, COALESCE(agg.purchase_qty, 0) AS purchase_qty, agg.dye_lots_text, d.logistics_no FROM inv_doc d LEFT JOIN bas_warehouse w ON w.id = CASE WHEN d.kind = 'IN' THEN d.to_warehouse_id ELSE d.from_warehouse_id END LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT SUM(i.purchase_qty) AS purchase_qty, string_agg(DISTINCT i.dye_lot, ',' ORDER BY i.dye_lot) AS dye_lots_text FROM inv_doc_item i WHERE i.doc_id = d.id) agg ON true WHERE d.source_type = 'PURCHASE_ORDER' AND d.source_id = #{id} AND d.status <> 'VOIDED' ORDER BY d.id
